d:
Marilith from Final Fantasy IX, in her humanoid form, reimagined as a soul-bringer to Garland, her master and creator, doing it through a dance of sorts.

The idea is that Marilith is dressed like a stripper or pole dancer in-game and in the official concept artwork depicting her, so she is reimagined as that but in a more dignified way of sorts.

Has bonus artworks featuring some of the FFIX girls.

If interested about reading my and others comics, you can go here:
